name: ContainerBuild
description: Build a container image, scan it for vulnerabilities with Trivy and push it to a registry.
author: OneK8s

inputs.name: image
inputs.label: Image
inputs.helpMarkDown: Image name, e.g. `myacr.azurecr.io/app`, or a name below the registry (e.g. `team/app`). Default: `<registry>/<project>/<repository>`.

inputs.name: containerRegistry
inputs.label: Container registry service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Docker Registry service connection used for push; its registry is also the default for automatic image names. Leave empty to use the `CONTAINER_REGISTRY`, `CONTAINER_REGISTRY_USERNAME` and `CONTAINER_REGISTRY_PASSWORD` variables (e.g. from a variable group) or an existing docker login.

inputs.name: registry
inputs.label: Registry
inputs.helpMarkDown: Registry (and optional namespace) used for automatic image names, e.g. `myacr.azurecr.io`. Default: the `CONTAINER_REGISTRY` variable, else the service connection's registry.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.label: Tags
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comma or newline separated tags. Default: short commit SHA plus `latest` (main/master), branch name, `pr-<n>` or git tag.

inputs.name: safeChain
inputs.label: Protect package installs with Aikido Safe Chain
inputs.helpMarkDown: Runs package managers (npm, yarn, pnpm, pip, uv, poetry, ...) in the Dockerfile's `RUN` instructions through [Aikido Safe Chain](https://github.com/AikidoSec/safe-chain), which blocks malware and packages newer than 48 hours. Nothing is added to the image.

inputs.name: sbom
inputs.label: Generate SBOM
inputs.helpMarkDown: Generates an SBOM of the image and publishes it as the `sbom` build artifact.

inputs.name: failOnVulnerabilities
inputs.label: Fail on vulnerabilities
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail the task and skip push when vulnerabilities are found.

outputVariables.name: tags
outputVariables.description: Comma separated list of full image references

outputVariables.name: scanReport
outputVariables.description: Path to the Trivy JSON report
